metadata.question: Did forest cover in the Bobiri Forest Reserve, Ghana, decline between 2003 and 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Bobiri Forest Reserve, Ghana (approximately 6.7°N, 1.3°W) - Time: Two periods - 2003 and 2023 - Collection: Hansen Global Forest Change or MODIS Land Cover for forest analysis - I'll use Hansen Global Forest Change which has tree cover data and loss year information 2. Masking strategy: - Hansen dataset has tree cover percentage for 2000, and loss year bands - I need to calculate forest cover for 2003 (tree cover 2000 minus losses 2001-2003) - And forest cover for 2023 (tree cover 2000 minus losses 2001-2023) - No cloud masking needed for this dataset 3. Logic: - Valid result: Calculate total forest pixels for both years - If 2023 forest < 2003 forest → Answer A (Yes, decline) - If 2023 forest >= 2003 forest → Answer B (No decline) - Check for null/invalid results → C3 - Check for empty data → C1 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Bobiri Forest Reserve geometry (approximate location in Ghana) const bobiri = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-1.35, 6.65], [-1.35, 6.75], [-1.25, 6.75], [-1.25, 6.65], [-1.35, 6.65]] ]); // 2. Load Hansen Global Forest Change dataset const hansen = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_11'); // 3. Get tree cover 2000 and loss year const treeCover2000 = hansen.select('treecover2000'); const lossYear = hansen.select('lossyear'); // Define forest as areas with >30% tree cover const forestMask2000 = treeCover2000.gte(30); // 4. Calculate forest for 2003 (losses from 2001-2003, which is year 1-3 in the dataset) const lossBy2003 = lossYear.gte(1).and(lossYear.lte(3)); const forest2003 = forestMask2000.and(lossBy2003.not()); // 5. Calculate forest for 2023 (losses from 2001-2023, which is year 1-23) const lossBy2023 = lossYear.gte(1).and(lossYear.lte(23)); const forest2023 = forestMask2000.and(lossBy2023.not()); // 6. Calculate forest area (pixel count) for both years const stats2003 = forest2003.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: bobiri, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2023 = forest2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: bobiri, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const forestPixels2003 = stats2003.get('treecover2000').getInfo(); const forestPixels2023 = stats2023.get('treecover2000').getInfo(); // 7. Check for valid data if (forestPixels2003 === null || forestPixels2023 === null) { console.log("Calculation returned null values."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (forestPixels2003 === 0 && forestPixels2023 === 0) { console.log("No valid forest pixels found."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 8. Calculate forest loss const forestLoss = forestPixels2003 - forestPixels2023; const percentChange = ((forestLoss / forestPixels2003) * 100).toFixed(2); // 9. Output results console.log(`Forest pixels 2003: ${forestPixels2003}`); console.log(`Forest pixels 2023: ${forestPixels2023}`); console.log(`Forest loss: ${forestLoss} pixels`); console.log(`Percent change: ${percentChange}%`); // 10. Final answer if (forestPixels2023 < forestPixels2003) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
